ORIGIN.quote: the true vendor (names and Azure IPs point at OpenAI's agent products; Confidence Medium-High, not provable from these logs alone)
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away understanding that the swarm was most likely OpenAI's — the report calls Azure ranges "hosting OpenAI's browsing infrastructure", counts 577 OpenAI-bearing labels as evidence of "one vendor's ecosystem", and assigns explicit Medium-High confidence that the fleet is OpenAI-hosted. It sits just below the top band only because the attribution is framed as a confidence-rated inference that is "not provable from these logs alone" rather than a flat conclusion, but it goes well beyond the mere "points to" of the 0.8 anchor by attaching a stated confidence level and listing it as the leading vendor hypothesis.
